text: Refrigerator - Door or Drawer Hard To Open Refrigerator - Door or Drawer Hard To Open When you open the fresh food or freezer door or drawer on your refrigerator, warm air rushes inside. When you close the door or drawer, all the warm air rushes to the evaporator, which in turn creates a vacuum. If you close one of the doors but then need to open one again right away, the vacuum makes the doors hard to open for about 10 to 15 seconds after closing. Once the air equalizes, the door or drawer will open as normal again.
